text: Look at this photo, Mai. This is an igloo in Alaska.
Wow, it's made of ice and snow! Do people really live in it?
In the past, the Inuit people built them for temporary shelters when they went hunting. Now they live in modern houses.
Their lifestyle has changed a lot, hasn't it?
Yes. They also use snowmobiles for transport instead of dogsleds.
They still eat a lot of meat and fish. They keep their traditional way of hunting and fishing.
I think it's important to keep some traditions even when the lifestyle changes.
